release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.44.2 upgrades the updater experience. Updates now download and SHA-256 verify without interrupting active work, then remain staged until the member chooses Apply now. The updater no longer uses browser-native confirmation dialogs. Verified staged updates persist across restarts and are re-verified immediately before application; tasks are stopped only during the final controlled restart. The update modal has been redesigned in Tachyon's dark blue, cyan, and purple visual system with integrated download progress, verified-release status, Continue in background, and distinct Download update and Apply now states. This release retains the v0.44.1 hosted licensing-authority Stable cutover and startup authentication-flash fix.
